mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1200 (thousands of units) and RSAFS growth is positive, it signals robust housing-led demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST, RSAFS, and SPX returns breaks down (p > 0.1) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (> 2% YoY) signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with strong INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 1.5% and CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% YoY, it signals monetary tightening with inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in PAYEMS (> 50,000 persons in one month) signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite labor market distress.

mechanism_narrative: During mid-cycle expansions, a GDPC1 quarterly growth rate between 1.5% and 2.5% YoY signals stable economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances with stable GDP growth during mid-cycle expansions.
